failure.body:
This is a TODO item.

Before buster, snmp docker image must use a local build python3.6. After we migrate snmp docker to Debian Buster (https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/pull/4529), we have official python 3.7 in Debian sources.

In stead of install it into snmp image, we could install it in docker-base image. It will be the same disk occupancy, but every derived image could benefit from fresh python3.7.

resolution.title: Install official python 3.7 in Debian sources into docker-base-buster
resolution.description:
Fixed #4531
Install official python 3.7 in Debian sources into docker-base-buster, no need to install in derived docker images. Same disk usage.

Verified all the python3 packages in docker-snmp-sv2 are installed and removed during `docker build`.
